name: Two Places at Once
body:
When in doubt, you can offer definitive proof that your social and vigilante identities are separate individuals.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 11, dual identity class feature or masked persona.

Benefit(s): Once per day, you can create an illusion of your social identity (if you are in your vigilante identity) or your vigilante identity (if you are in your social identity).

This functions as silent image, but is a supernatural ability. If you’re at least 4th level, it functions instead as minor image. If you’re at least 7th level, it functions instead as major image. If you’re at least 10th level, it can function instead as persistent image. If you’re at least 13th level, it can function instead as programmed image. As long as the image does not directly interact with a viewer, add any Disguise bonus you receive from your seamless guise class feature to the save DC to detect the illusion.

Character Options: The Vigilante. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
